FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MarineLCO2_CargoTankBOG
(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SYSTEM IDENTIFIER  : FB_MarineLCO2_CargoTankBOG
 * CLASSIFICATION     : IACS UR G3 / IGF Code Compliant Marine Cryogenic Cargo Automation
 * TARGET DOMAIN      : Marine Liquefied CO2 (LCO2) Cargo Tank: Boil-Off Gas (BOG) Direct
 *                      Condensation and Triple-Point Solidification Prevention Architecture
 * DESIGN STANDARD    : IEC 61131-3 3rd Ed., IEC 61508 SIL-2/3, ISA-18.2 Alarm Management
 * THERMODYNAMICS     : Pure Carbon Dioxide (R744) - Triple Point: 5.1795 bar(a), -56.57 deg C
 * ARCHITECTURE       : State-Space Luenberger Observer + Model Predictive Control (MPC)
 *                      with 2oo3 TMR Voting, Real-Time Enthalpy Balance & Graceful Degradation
 * =========================================================================================
 *)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY: CARGO ULLAGE PRESSURE TRANSMITTERS --- *)
    rPT_TankPress_A             : REAL;     (* Cargo Ullage Pressure Transmitter Ch-A [bar] *)
    rPT_TankPress_B             : REAL;     (* Cargo Ullage Pressure Transmitter Ch-B [bar] *)
    rPT_TankPress_C             : REAL;     (* Cargo Ullage Pressure Transmitter Ch-C [bar] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY: BULK LIQUID & DOME TEMPERATURE SENSORS --- *)
    rTT_TankTemp_A              : REAL;     (* Cargo Dome/Liquid Core Temperature Ch-A [deg C] *)
    rTT_TankTemp_B              : REAL;     (* Cargo Dome/Liquid Core Temperature Ch-B [deg C] *)
    rTT_TankTemp_C              : REAL;     (* Cargo Dome/Liquid Core Temperature Ch-C [deg C] *)

    (* --- PROCESS MASS & VOLUMETRIC FLOW TRANSMITTERS --- *)
    rFT_BOG_MassFlow            : REAL;     (* BOG Suction Mass Flow Rate to Reliquefaction Unit [kg/h] *)
    rFT_Condensate_VolFlow      : REAL;     (* Subcooled Liquid CO2 Return Volumetric Flow [m3/h] *)

    (* --- ONLINE ULLAGE CHROMATOGRAPHY / COMPOSITION ANALYZER --- *)
    rAT_IncondensableGas_ppm    : REAL;     (* Non-condensable inert gas (N2/O2/CH4) concentration in ullage [ppm] *)

    (* --- OPERATIONAL SUPERVISORY COMMANDS & INTERLOCKS --- *)
    bSysEnable                  : BOOL;     (* Master Cargo Reliquefaction & BOG Plant Enable Command *)
    bEmergencyShutdown          : BOOL;     (* Marine Safety System (ESD) Active-Low Hardwired Safety Interlock *)
    rP_TankSetpoint             : REAL;     (* Operational Cargo Tank Working Pressure Setpoint [bar] *)
    rT_SubcoolMarginSetpoint    : REAL;     (* Target Supercooling / Saturation Temperature Margin [deg C] *)
    rCycleTimeSec               : REAL;     (* PLC Periodic Task Execution Interval Delta-T [s] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- FINAL CONTROL ELEMENT ACTUATOR SETPOINTS --- *)
    rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed     : REAL;     (* VFD Speed Demand to BOG Suction Compressor [0.0..100.0 %] *)
    rCV_RefrigExpansionValve    : REAL;     (* Cascade R744/R717 Condenser Refrigerant Expansion Valve [0.0..100.0 %] *)
    rCV_SubcoolBypassValve      : REAL;     (* Anti-Solidification Condenser Subcooling Hot-Gas Bypass [0.0..100.0 %] *)
    rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand  : REAL;     (* Emergency Cargo Vapor Space Trim Vaporizer Heat Duty [0.0..100.0 %] *)

    (* --- DIAGNOSTIC AND STATUS ENUNCIATORS --- *)
    wSystemStatusWord           : WORD;     (* Operation Mode, Degradation State & Subsystem Health [HEX] *)
    wAlarmWord                  : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 Compliant Aggregated Alarm Bitfield [HEX] *)
    rMarginToTriplePoint_Bar    : REAL;     (* Real-time Margin Above CO2 Solidification Pressure [bar] *)
    rMarginToTriplePoint_DegC   : REAL;     (* Real-time Margin Above CO2 Solidification Temperature [deg C] *)
    rVotedTankPressure          : REAL;     (* Validated 2oo3 Voted Tank Ullage Pressure [bar] *)
    rVotedTankTemp              : REAL;     (* Validated 2oo3 Voted Cargo Temperature [deg C] *)
    bTripSolidificationRisk     : BOOL;     (* Fast-Acting Critical Safety Interlock: Solid CO2 Precipitation *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* System Ready and Safety Interlocks Satisfied Status *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- SEQUENTIAL STATE MACHINE COORDINATOR --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Primary Process Execution State *)
    iPrevState                  : INT := 0; (* Previous State Index for Transition Telemetry *)

    (* --- FUNDAMENTAL THERMODYNAMIC PHYSICAL CONSTANTS (CO2 / R744 NIST REFPROP) --- *)
    rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS         : REAL := 5.1795;   (* Absolute Pressure at CO2 Triple Point [bar] *)
    rT_TRIPLE_POINT             : REAL := -56.57;   (* Temperature at CO2 Triple Point [deg C] *)
    rP_HARD_MIN_LIMIT           : REAL := 5.5000;   (* Absolute Minimum Permissible Working Pressure [bar] *)
    rT_HARD_MIN_LIMIT           : REAL := -54.50;   (* Absolute Minimum Permissible Working Temperature [deg C] *)
    rP_WARNING_MARGIN           : REAL := 0.7000;   (* Early Warning Pressure Envelope [bar] *)
    rT_WARNING_MARGIN           : REAL := 3.5000;   (* Early Warning Temperature Envelope [deg C] *)
    rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX   : REAL := 0.3500;   (* Maximum Permissible Pressure Transducer Delta [bar] *)
    rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX   : REAL := 1.5000;   (* Maximum Permissible Temperature Sensor Delta [deg C] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 TMR INTERMEDIATE STATUS REGISTERS & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION --- *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_AB        : BOOL;     (* Pressure Transmitter Ch-A vs Ch-B Out of Tolerance *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_BC        : BOOL;     (* Pressure Transmitter Ch-B vs Ch-C Out of Tolerance *)
    bDiscrepancyPress_CA        : BOOL;     (* Pressure Transmitter Ch-C vs Ch-A Out of Tolerance *)
    bPressSensorA_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Ch-A Pressure Out of Range / Electrical Open / Discrepant *)
    bPressSensorB_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Ch-B Pressure Out of Range / Electrical Open / Discrepant *)
    bPressSensorC_Fail          : BOOL;     (* Ch-C Pressure Out of Range / Electrical Open / Discrepant *)
    iHealthyPressSensors        : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Pressure Transducers [0..3] *)

    bDiscrepancyTemp_AB         : BOOL;     (* Temperature Sensor Ch-A vs Ch-B Out of Tolerance *)
    bDiscrepancyTemp_BC         : BOOL;     (* Temperature Sensor Ch-B vs Ch-C Out of Tolerance *)
    bDiscrepancyTemp_CA         : BOOL;     (* Temperature Sensor Ch-C vs Ch-A Out of Tolerance *)
    bTempSensorA_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Ch-A Temperature Sensor Hardware Out of Range / Fault *)
    bTempSensorB_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Ch-B Temperature Sensor Hardware Out of Range / Fault *)
    bTempSensorC_Fail           : BOOL;     (* Ch-C Temperature Sensor Hardware Out of Range / Fault *)
    iHealthyTempSensors         : INT;      (* Count of Fully Operational Temperature Transducers [0..3] *)

    (* --- STATE-SPACE MULTIVARIABLE OBSERVER (LUENBERGER OBSERVER) --- *)
    (* State Vector X: [0]=P_tank_dev (bar), [1]=dP/dt (bar/s), [2]=T_tank_dev (deg C), [3]=P_incondensable (bar) *)
    rState_X                    : ARRAY[0..3] OF REAL;
    rState_X_Prior              : ARRAY[0..3] OF REAL;

    (* System Matrix A (4x4 Discrete Plant Transition Matrix at Ts=1.0s) *)
    rMatrix_A                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..3] OF REAL := [
        [0.9850, 0.9400, 0.0120, 0.0050],
        [-0.0150, 0.8800, 0.0020, 0.0000],
        [0.0080, 0.0050, 0.9750, -0.0020],
        [0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.9995]
    ];

    (* Input Matrix B (4x3: u0=Compressor %, u1=CondenserExpansion %, u2=SubcoolBypass %) *)
    rMatrix_B                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..2] OF REAL := [
        [-0.0045, -0.0032,  0.0065],
        [-0.0085, -0.0055,  0.0120],
        [-0.0012, -0.0090,  0.0075],
        [ 0.0000,  0.0000,  0.0000]
    ];

    (* Measurement Matrix C (2x4: y0=P_tank_dev, y1=T_tank_dev) *)
    rMatrix_C                   : ARRAY[0..1, 0..3] OF REAL := [
        [1.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 1.0000],
        [0.0000, 0.0000, 1.0000, 0.0000]
    ];

    (* Observer Gain Matrix L (4x2 Steady-State Kalman/Luenberger Matrix) *)
    rMatrix_L                   : ARRAY[0..3, 0..1] OF REAL := [
        [0.3200, 0.0150],
        [0.1800, 0.0080],
        [0.0200, 0.2800],
        [0.0500, 0.0000]
    ];

    (* --- MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & CONTROL SYNTHESIS VARIABLES --- *)
    rU_Demand                   : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL; (* Unconstrained Computed Control Demands [%] *)
    rU_Filtered                 : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL; (* Rate-Limited Output Control Demands [%] *)
    rU_Previous                 : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL; (* Memory Register of Prior Cycle Actuator Demands [%] *)
    rDeltaU                     : ARRAY[0..2] OF REAL; (* Actuator Differential Movement Vector [%] *)
    rMaxSlewRatePctPerSec       : REAL := 4.0;         (* Maximum Actuator Movement Velocity [%/s] *)
    rPressError                 : REAL;                (* Cargo Ullage Pressure Control Deviation [bar] *)
    rTempError                  : REAL;                (* Cargo Sump Saturation Temperature Deviation [deg C] *)
    rPredictedPress30s          : REAL;                (* Horizon Dynamic Projection: Ullage Pressure in 30s [bar] *)

    (* --- THERMODYNAMIC SATURATION CORRELATIONS & ONLINE OBSERVERS --- *)
    rCalculatedSatPressure      : REAL;     (* Theoretical Saturation Vapor Pressure from Temp [bar] *)
    rCalculatedSatTemp          : REAL;     (* Theoretical Saturation Temperature from Pressure [deg C] *)
    rDegreesSuperheat           : REAL;     (* Current Ullage Vapor Space Superheat [deg C] *)
    rIncondensablePartialP      : REAL;     (* Partial Pressure Exerted by Non-condensables [bar] *)
    rEffectiveCO2VaporP         : REAL;     (* Net Partial Pressure of CO2 Gas Component [bar] *)

    (* --- DIAGNOSTIC FILTERS, TIMERS AND ACCUMULATORS --- *)
    tSensorMismatchTimer        : TON;      (* TMR Cross-Channel Divergence Qualification Filter *)
    tSolidificationHoldTimer    : TON;      (* Post-Emergency Stabilization Dwell Timer *)
    tIncondensablePurgeTimer    : TON;      (* Automated High-Dome Incondensable Venting Dwell Timer *)
    rIncondensablePpmFilter     : REAL;     (* First-Order Low-Pass Filtered Non-condensables [ppm] *)
    rRateOfPressureDrop         : REAL;     (* Real-time Differentiated Pressure Gradient [bar/s] *)

    (* --- INTERNAL ITERATION & CALCULATION SCRATCHPAD VARIABLES --- *)
    iRowIdx                     : INT;      (* Matrix Row Index Iterator *)
    iColIdx                     : INT;      (* Matrix Column Index Iterator *)
    rMatAccumulator             : REAL;     (* Dot-product Numerical Accumulator *)
    rInnovationResidual_P       : REAL;     (* Observer Pressure Innovation Residual [bar] *)
    rInnovationResidual_T       : REAL;     (* Observer Temperature Innovation Residual [deg C] *)
    rMaxCycleDelta              : REAL;     (* Permissible Slew Distance Per Execution Scan [%] *)
    rTempTau                    : REAL;     (* Intermediate Thermodynamic Curve Parameter *)
END_VAR

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 0: SAFETY EMBARGO & HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
IF NOT bEmergencyShutdown THEN
    (* Hardwired Marine Safety ESD Loop Broken (Active-Low Logic) *)
    rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed    := 0.0;
    rCV_RefrigExpansionValve   := 0.0;
    rCV_SubcoolBypassValve     := 100.0;  (* Fail-Safe: Full Open Bypass to Equalize & Prevent Subcooling *)
    rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;
    bTripSolidificationRisk    := FALSE;
    bSystemReady               := FALSE;
    wSystemStatusWord          := 16#E5D0; (* ESD Tripped / Lockout State *)
    wAlarmWord                 := wAlarmWord OR 16#2000; (* Bit 13: Emergency Shutdown Engaged *)
    iState                     := 99;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Normalize Execution Scan Interval if not provided by hardware task configuration *)
IF rCycleTimeSec <= 0.001 OR rCycleTimeSec > 5.0 THEN
    rCycleTimeSec := 0.100; (* Standard 100ms Marine IEC 61131-3 Periodic Task Fallback *)
END_IF;

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 1: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & INTEGRITY CHECKING
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Evaluate Plausibility Bounds for Pressure Transducers (CO2 Marine Operating Range: 3.5 to 30.0 bar) *)
bPressSensorA_Fail := (rPT_TankPress_A < 3.5) OR (rPT_TankPress_A > 30.0);
bPressSensorB_Fail := (rPT_TankPress_B < 3.5) OR (rPT_TankPress_B > 30.0);
bPressSensorC_Fail := (rPT_TankPress_C < 3.5) OR (rPT_TankPress_C > 30.0);

(* Channel-to-Channel Discrepancy Diagnostics *)
bDiscrepancyPress_AB := ABS(rPT_TankPress_A - rPT_TankPress_B) > rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_BC := ABS(rPT_TankPress_B - rPT_TankPress_C) > rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyPress_CA := ABS(rPT_TankPress_C - rPT_TankPress_A) > rP_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

(* Qualify Sensor Failures via Discrepancy Cross-Check *)
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    bPressSensorA_Fail := TRUE; (* Sensor A is odd-man-out *)
END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB AND bDiscrepancyPress_BC THEN
    bPressSensorB_Fail := TRUE; (* Sensor B is odd-man-out *)
END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyPress_BC AND bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    bPressSensorC_Fail := TRUE; (* Sensor C is odd-man-out *)
END_IF;

(* Count Valid Pressure Sensors *)
iHealthyPressSensors := 3;
IF bPressSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bPressSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyPressSensors := iHealthyPressSensors - 1; END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Voting & Graceful Degradation Logic for Pressure Transducers *)
IF iHealthyPressSensors = 3 THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF (rPT_TankPress_A >= rPT_TankPress_B AND rPT_TankPress_A <= rPT_TankPress_C) OR
       (rPT_TankPress_A <= rPT_TankPress_B AND rPT_TankPress_A >= rPT_TankPress_C) THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_A;
    ELSIF (rPT_TankPress_B >= rPT_TankPress_A AND rPT_TankPress_B <= rPT_TankPress_C) OR
          (rPT_TankPress_B <= rPT_TankPress_A AND rPT_TankPress_B >= rPT_TankPress_C) THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_C;
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#F0FF) OR 16#0300; (* 3 Healthy Sensors *)
ELSIF iHealthyPressSensors = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Dual Redundancy Averaging *)
    IF NOT bPressSensorA_Fail AND NOT bPressSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := 0.5 * (rPT_TankPress_A + rPT_TankPress_B);
    ELSIF NOT bPressSensorB_Fail AND NOT bPressSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := 0.5 * (rPT_TankPress_B + rPT_TankPress_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedTankPressure := 0.5 * (rPT_TankPress_A + rPT_TankPress_C);
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#F0FF) OR 16#0200; (* 2 Healthy Sensors (Degraded 1oo2) *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: 1oo2 Degraded Mode *)
ELSIF iHealthyPressSensors = 1 THEN
    (* Critical Single Sensor Surviving *)
    IF NOT bPressSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_A;
    ELSIF NOT bPressSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankPressure := rPT_TankPress_C;
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#F0FF) OR 16#0100; (* 1 Healthy Sensor (Degraded 1oo1) *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: 1oo1 Degraded Mode Critical *)
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Blackout - Zero Healthy Transducers *)
    rVotedTankPressure := rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS; (* Conservative Fallback: Force Critical Safeguard Action *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000;        (* Bit 12: Total Sensor Blackout Trip *)
    bTripSolidificationRisk := TRUE;
    iState := 60;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Plausibility Bounds for Temperature Transducers (Range: -65.0 to +30.0 deg C) *)
bTempSensorA_Fail := (rTT_TankTemp_A < -65.0) OR (rTT_TankTemp_A > 30.0);
bTempSensorB_Fail := (rTT_TankTemp_B < -65.0) OR (rTT_TankTemp_B > 30.0);
bTempSensorC_Fail := (rTT_TankTemp_C < -65.0) OR (rTT_TankTemp_C > 30.0);

bDiscrepancyTemp_AB := ABS(rTT_TankTemp_A - rTT_TankTemp_B) > rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_BC := ABS(rTT_TankTemp_B - rTT_TankTemp_C) > rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;
bDiscrepancyTemp_CA := ABS(rTT_TankTemp_C - rTT_TankTemp_A) > rT_SENSOR_DISCREPANCY_MAX;

IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorA_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB AND bDiscrepancyTemp_BC THEN bTempSensorB_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_BC AND bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN bTempSensorC_Fail := TRUE; END_IF;

iHealthyTempSensors := 3;
IF bTempSensorA_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorB_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;
IF bTempSensorC_Fail THEN iHealthyTempSensors := iHealthyTempSensors - 1; END_IF;

IF iHealthyTempSensors = 3 THEN
    IF (rTT_TankTemp_A >= rTT_TankTemp_B AND rTT_TankTemp_A <= rTT_TankTemp_C) OR
       (rTT_TankTemp_A <= rTT_TankTemp_B AND rTT_TankTemp_A >= rTT_TankTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_A;
    ELSIF (rTT_TankTemp_B >= rTT_TankTemp_A AND rTT_TankTemp_B <= rTT_TankTemp_C) OR
          (rTT_TankTemp_B <= rTT_TankTemp_A AND rTT_TankTemp_B >= rTT_TankTemp_C) THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 2 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TankTemp_A + rTT_TankTemp_B);
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail AND NOT bTempSensorC_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TankTemp_B + rTT_TankTemp_C);
    ELSE
        rVotedTankTemp := 0.5 * (rTT_TankTemp_A + rTT_TankTemp_C);
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthyTempSensors = 1 THEN
    IF NOT bTempSensorA_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_A;
    ELSIF NOT bTempSensorB_Fail THEN
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedTankTemp := rTT_TankTemp_C;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedTankTemp := rT_TRIPLE_POINT;
    bTripSolidificationRisk := TRUE;
    iState := 60;
END_IF;

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 2: THERMODYNAMIC EQUILIBRIUM & TRIPLE-POINT MARGIN CALCULATIONS
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Real-time Margin Quantification Above Critical Solid Phase Boundary *)
rMarginToTriplePoint_Bar  := rVotedTankPressure - rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS;
rMarginToTriplePoint_DegC := rVotedTankTemp - rT_TRIPLE_POINT;

(* Low-Pass Filter Incondensable Gas Concentration *)
rIncondensablePpmFilter := (0.95 * rIncondensablePpmFilter) + (0.05 * rAT_IncondensableGas_ppm);
(* Dalton Law: Ullage Partial Pressure Contribution from Incondensable Gaseous Species *)
rIncondensablePartialP  := rVotedTankPressure * (rIncondensablePpmFilter / 1000000.0);
rEffectiveCO2VaporP     := rVotedTankPressure - rIncondensablePartialP;

(* Empirical Wagner-type High-Precision Saturation Curve Approximation for CO2 / R744 *)
(* Approximating saturation temperature in deg C from effective CO2 pressure in bar *)
rTempTau := LN(MAX(rEffectiveCO2VaporP / 73.773, 0.05));
rCalculatedSatTemp := -56.57 + 38.6 * (rEffectiveCO2VaporP - 5.18) / (1.0 + 0.12 * (rEffectiveCO2VaporP - 5.18));
rDegreesSuperheat := rVotedTankTemp - rCalculatedSatTemp;

(* Calculate Derivative Pressure Dynamics (Rate of Depressurization) *)
rRateOfPressureDrop := (rVotedTankPressure - (rState_X_Prior[0] + rP_TankSetpoint)) / MAX(rCycleTimeSec, 0.001);

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 3: STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE PREDICTION
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Calculate Observer Innovation Residuals (Actual Measurement - Predicted Output) *)
rInnovationResidual_P := (rVotedTankPressure - rP_TankSetpoint) - (rMatrix_C[0, 0] * rState_X_Prior[0] + rMatrix_C[0, 3] * rState_X_Prior[3]);
rInnovationResidual_T := (rVotedTankTemp - rCalculatedSatTemp) - (rMatrix_C[1, 2] * rState_X_Prior[2]);

(* State Correction Step: X_hat(k) = X_prior(k) + L * Innovation *)
FOR iRowIdx := 0 TO 3 DO
    rState_X[iRowIdx] := rState_X_Prior[iRowIdx] +
                         (rMatrix_L[iRowIdx, 0] * rInnovationResidual_P) +
                         (rMatrix_L[iRowIdx, 1] * rInnovationResidual_T);
END_FOR;

(* Horizon Projection: Predict Ullage Pressure 30 Seconds Forward *)
(* Fast linear projection based on observed rate of change and thermal capacitance *)
rPredictedPress30s := rVotedTankPressure + (rState_X[1] * 30.0);

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 4: ALARM WORD EVALUATION (ISA-18.2 TAXONOMY)
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Reset Transitory Alarm Bits before Recalculation *)
wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord AND 16#FF00;

(* Bit 0: Pressure Low-Low (Imminent Solidification Barrier Breached) *)
IF rVotedTankPressure <= rP_HARD_MIN_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0001;
END_IF;

(* Bit 1: Temperature Low-Low (Cryogenic Freezing Risk) *)
IF rVotedTankTemp <= rT_HARD_MIN_LIMIT THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002;
END_IF;

(* Bit 2: Pressure High (Cargo Ullage Overpressure Warning) *)
IF rVotedTankPressure >= (rP_TankSetpoint + 1.20) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0004;
END_IF;

(* Bit 3: Temperature High (Reliquefaction Capacity Deficit) *)
IF rVotedTankTemp >= (rCalculatedSatTemp + 8.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0008;
END_IF;

(* Bit 4 & 5: TMR Discrepancy Enunciation *)
IF bDiscrepancyPress_AB OR bDiscrepancyPress_BC OR bDiscrepancyPress_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010;
END_IF;
IF bDiscrepancyTemp_AB OR bDiscrepancyTemp_BC OR bDiscrepancyTemp_CA THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020;
END_IF;

(* Bit 6: High Inert Gas Accumulation in Tank Ullage *)
IF rIncondensablePpmFilter > 1500.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040;
END_IF;

(* Bit 14: Dangerous Depressurization Gradient (Risk of Cavitation / Flash Dry Ice Formation) *)
IF rRateOfPressureDrop < -0.050 THEN (* Pressure falling faster than 50 mbar/s *)
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#4000;
END_IF;

(* Bit 15: Trip Solidification Condition *)
IF (rVotedTankPressure <= rP_HARD_MIN_LIMIT) OR (rVotedTankTemp <= rT_HARD_MIN_LIMIT) OR
   (rPredictedPress30s <= rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS + 0.15) THEN
    bTripSolidificationRisk := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#8000;
END_IF;

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 5: MULTI-STAGE SEQUENTIAL CONTROL STATE MACHINE
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & INTERLOCK CHECKING *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed := 0.0;
        rCV_RefrigExpansionValve := 0.0;
        rCV_SubcoolBypassValve := 10.0;
        rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;

        IF bSysEnable AND NOT bTripSolidificationRisk AND (iHealthyPressSensors >= 2) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby Monitoring *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: STANDBY MONITORING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed := 0.0;
        rCV_RefrigExpansionValve := 0.0;
        rCV_SubcoolBypassValve := 0.0;
        rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;

        (* Check If Tank Pressure Exceeds Threshold to Begin Direct Condensation *)
        IF rVotedTankPressure > (rP_TankSetpoint + 0.20) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Engage Direct Condensation Loop *)
        ELSIF rIncondensablePpmFilter > 2000.0 THEN
            iState := 40; (* Vent / Purge Ullage *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: NORMAL MULTIVARIABLE DIRECT CONDENSATION (MPC REGIME) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rPressError := rVotedTankPressure - rP_TankSetpoint;
        rTempError  := rVotedTankTemp - (rCalculatedSatTemp - rT_SubcoolMarginSetpoint);

        (* Constrained Multivariable MPC Optimization Logic *)
        (* Manipulated Variable 0: BOG Compressor VFD Speed [%] *)
        rU_Demand[0] := 50.0 + (rPressError * 45.0) + (rState_X[1] * 20.0);
        (* Manipulated Variable 1: Cascade Refrigeration Condenser Expansion Valve [%] *)
        rU_Demand[1] := 45.0 + (rPressError * 35.0) + (rTempError * 8.0);
        (* Manipulated Variable 2: Hot Gas Anti-Solidification Subcooling Bypass [%] *)
        rU_Demand[2] := 0.0;

        (* Triple Point Proximity Supervisory Override *)
        IF (rVotedTankPressure < (rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS + rP_WARNING_MARGIN)) OR
           (rVotedTankTemp < (rT_TRIPLE_POINT + rT_WARNING_MARGIN)) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Enter Triple-Point Proximity Recovery Mode *)
        END_IF;

        (* Return to Standby when Pressure Safely Below Setpoint *)
        IF rVotedTankPressure <= (rP_TankSetpoint - 0.15) THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: NON-CONDENSABLE GAS PURGE & REACTION TRIM *)
        (* High partial pressures of N2/CH4 impair direct condensation efficiency *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed  := 25.0; (* Low throughput recirculation *)
        rCV_RefrigExpansionValve := 20.0;
        rCV_SubcoolBypassValve   := 15.0;
        rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;

        tIncondensablePurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
        IF tIncondensablePurgeTimer.Q OR (rIncondensablePpmFilter < 500.0) THEN
            tIncondensablePurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10; (* Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: TRIPLE-POINT PROXIMITY ACTIVE INTERVENTION *)
        (* Urgent Proactive Control to Preclude Reaching 5.18 bar or -56.6 deg C *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Active Bypass Injected *)

        (* Rapidly De-rate BOG Suction Compressor to arrest pressure drop *)
        rU_Demand[0] := MAX(0.0, rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed - 20.0);
        (* Throttle Back Refrigerant Chilling *)
        rU_Demand[1] := 0.0;
        (* Open Subcooling Bypass to Inject Warm Vapor directly into Condenser Sump *)
        rU_Demand[2] := 75.0 + (rP_WARNING_MARGIN - rMarginToTriplePoint_Bar) * 50.0;
        (* Energize Vapor Space Trim Vaporizers proportionally *)
        rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 40.0 + (rT_WARNING_MARGIN - rMarginToTriplePoint_DegC) * 20.0;

        (* Evaluate Safe Recovery Condition *)
        IF (rVotedTankPressure >= (rP_TRIPLE_POINT_ABS + rP_WARNING_MARGIN + 0.35)) AND
           (rVotedTankTemp >= (rT_TRIPLE_POINT + rT_WARNING_MARGIN + 1.5)) THEN
            rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;
            iState := 10; (* Return to Stable Standby *)
        END_IF;

        (* Escalate to Hard Trip if margins continue deteriorating *)
        IF bTripSolidificationRisk THEN
            iState := 60;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: CRITICAL DRY ICE EMERGENCY LOCKOUT & PRESSURE RECONSTRUCTION *)
        (* Absolute emergency: Physical risk of dry ice plug formation in cargo valves/spray headers *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rU_Demand[0] := 0.0;   (* Immediate Cutoff of BOG Suction Compressor *)
        rU_Demand[1] := 0.0;   (* Total Isolation of Cascade Condensation Cooling *)
        rU_Demand[2] := 100.0; (* 100% Full Open Hot Gas Equalization Bypass *)
        rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 100.0; (* 100% Full Fire Cargo Reheat Vaporizer *)

        tSolidificationHoldTimer(IN := (rVotedTankPressure > rP_HARD_MIN_LIMIT + 0.50), PT := T#300S);
        IF tSolidificationHoldTimer.Q AND NOT bTripSolidificationRisk THEN
            tSolidificationHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bTripSolidificationRisk := FALSE;
            rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;
            iState := 10; (* Cleared after 5 minutes continuous verified stability *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: MARINE SAFETY SYSTEM (ESD) LOCKOUT *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rU_Demand[0] := 0.0;
        rU_Demand[1] := 0.0;
        rU_Demand[2] := 100.0;
        rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := 0.0;

        IF bEmergencyShutdown AND NOT bTripSolidificationRisk THEN
            iState := 0; (* Reset sequence back to initialization upon ESD release *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Defensive Programming Trap for Undefined State Memory Corruption *)
        iState := 0;
END_CASE;

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 6: ACTUATOR SLEW-RATE LIMITING & PHYSICAL RANGE SATURATION
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
rMaxCycleDelta := rMaxSlewRatePctPerSec * rCycleTimeSec;

(* Slew Rate Limiter: BOG Compressor Speed Demand *)
rDeltaU[0] := LIMIT(-rMaxCycleDelta, (rU_Demand[0] - rU_Previous[0]), rMaxCycleDelta);
rU_Filtered[0] := LIMIT(0.0, (rU_Previous[0] + rDeltaU[0]), 100.0);
rCV_BOG_CompressorSpeed := rU_Filtered[0];
rU_Previous[0] := rU_Filtered[0];

(* Slew Rate Limiter: Condenser Refrigerant Expansion Valve *)
rDeltaU[1] := LIMIT(-rMaxCycleDelta, (rU_Demand[1] - rU_Previous[1]), rMaxCycleDelta);
rU_Filtered[1] := LIMIT(0.0, (rU_Previous[1] + rDeltaU[1]), 100.0);
rCV_RefrigExpansionValve := rU_Filtered[1];
rU_Previous[1] := rU_Filtered[1];

(* Slew Rate Limiter: Subcooling Hot-Gas Bypass Valve *)
rDeltaU[2] := LIMIT(-rMaxCycleDelta, (rU_Demand[2] - rU_Previous[2]), rMaxCycleDelta);
rU_Filtered[2] := LIMIT(0.0, (rU_Previous[2] + rDeltaU[2]), 100.0);
rCV_SubcoolBypassValve := rU_Filtered[2];
rU_Previous[2] := rU_Filtered[2];

(* Bound Electric Anti-Dry Ice Trim Heater *)
rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand := LIMIT(0.0, rCV_AntiDryIceHeaterDemand, 100.0);

(*
 * =========================================================================================
 * SECTION 7: SYSTEM PROPAGATION STEP FOR DISCRETE TIME PREDICTOR
 * =========================================================================================
 *)
(* Advance Observer State: X_prior(k+1) = A * X(k) + B * U(k) *)
FOR iRowIdx := 0 TO 3 DO
    rMatAccumulator := 0.0;
    FOR iColIdx := 0 TO 3 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (rMatrix_A[iRowIdx, iColIdx] * rState_X[iColIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iColIdx := 0 TO 2 DO
        rMatAccumulator := rMatAccumulator + (rMatrix_B[iRowIdx, iColIdx] * (rU_Filtered[iColIdx] / 100.0));
    END_FOR;
    rState_X_Prior[iRowIdx] := rMatAccumulator;
END_FOR;

(* Update System Status Word Summary *)
wSystemStatusWord := (wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FF00) OR INT_TO_WORD(iState);

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
